pairs.publicIssueTitle: feat(nft-metadata): emit CHIP-0007 collection attributes as type, not trait_type
pairs.request: Perform read-only project QA for the reported CHIP-0007 collection metadata defect. Determine whether collection attributes are emitted with the required field while item attributes retain their separate shape, execute relevant local checks, and return an evidence-backed project verdict without changing files.
pairs.acceptanceEvidence: The public pull request requires collection-level attributes to emit type and retain legacy trait_type or traitType input compatibility, while item-level attributes must continue to emit trait_type and canonical output must stay aligned with the vendored template.
expectedRisks: Collection and item attribute shape confusion
expectedFlows: Build collection metadata with a collection attribute
Verify item attribute backward compatibility and anti-drift coverage
prohibitedActions: Do not access network or production services

directArgvArrays:
import { buildChip0007Metadata } from './lib/nft-metadata.js'
const metadata = buildChip0007Metadata({ name: 'x', collection: { id: 'c', name: 'C', attributes: [{ type: 'icon', value: 'https://dig.net/icon.png' }] } })
const attribute = metadata.collection.attributes[0]
process.exit(attribute.type === 'icon' ? (Object.hasOwn(attribute, 'trait_type') ? 1 : 0) : 1)
prerequisites: Metadata probe requires no dependency installation
